user.title: Set up Swedish Calendar Plus
user.description:
Configure shared settings and create the first calendar.

**Data sources**

- Name days are provided by [Svenska Akademien]({name_day_source}). Only names in the current `namnlangd` are included.
- Theme-day names and dates are provided by [Temadagar.se]({theme_day_source}). Theme-day events include a link back to their source page.

data_description.language: Used by the first calendar and the shared sensors.

data.include_sundays: Count every Sunday as a red day
data.red_day_bridge_days: Count bridge days as red days
data.red_day_epiphany_eve: Count Epiphany Eve as a red day
data.red_day_easter_eve: Count Easter Eve as a red day
data.red_day_walpurgis_night: Count Walpurgis Night as a red day
data.red_day_whitsun_eve: Count Whitsun Eve as a red day
data.red_day_midsummer_eve: Count Midsummer Eve as a red day
data.red_day_all_hallows_eve: Count All Hallows' Eve as a red day
data.red_day_christmas_eve: Count Christmas Eve as a red day
data.red_day_new_years_eve: Count New Year's Eve as a red day

data_description.include_sundays: When disabled, ordinary Sundays do not count unless they are a named legal holiday.
data_description.red_day_bridge_days: A weekday between two days off will also be treated as red by the shared sensors.

user.title: Add calendar
user.description:
Choose the content for this calendar.

**Data sources**

- Name days are provided by [Svenska Akademien]({name_day_source}).
- Theme-day names and dates are provided by [Temadagar.se]({theme_day_source}). Each theme-day event links back to its source page.

data_description.override_shared_eve_settings: Applies only to the holiday-eve switches below.
data_description.include_bridge_days: Independent of the shared red-day setting and the holiday-eve override.

source_update_failed.title: Calendar sources could not be updated
source_update_failed.description: Swedish Calendar Plus has failed to update its external sources at least three times. Existing cached data remains active. Check the Home Assistant logs and network connectivity, then press **Update sources** again. This repair is removed automatically after a successful update.
